content.text: The cheapest improvement available: data that is already synced and that no recipe or skill line ever asks for. Two independent sweeps found the same list.
Present in the schema, absent from docs/RECIPES.md and skills/gadak/SKILL.md:
- components — a JSON array, filled on 4368 of 7163 live issues; fix_versions has a recipe and this does not
- duedate — "what is overdue and not done" has no query, though the CLI can already write it
- epic_key / parent_key / hierarchy_level — "what is under this epic" and "children of KEY"; the README has a GROUP BY that never made it into RECIPES
- links — 8939 rows live, 122 in demo; not one query anywhere. "What blocks this" and "what duplicates what"
- comments.author_id — RECIPES currently keys a comment query on the author's display name, which is both localized and ambiguous between two people with the same name; the id column is right there
- story_points via json_extract(custom, ...) — filled on 187 live rows, no query anywhere
- comment_count, cloned_from, resolution, environment_text — minor, but each is a column nothing reads

Also worth one line each: a mention in a comment lives in the ADF body, so "who was @-mentioned" is a json walk and not body_text LIKE '%@%'; and the JQL subset does support currentUser(), startOfDay() and endOfDay() — do not write that functions are all dropped.
Fix shape: one RECIPES section and a short skill addition, all keyed on ids and status_category. No code.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (tracks A, B and C independently).
